name: En
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Li Jinfang 2006. Studies on endangered languages in the Southwest China. Beijing: Minzu University Press, p. 90 (En/Nung Ven; cited for its 6-tone system); not online

sources.citation: Phan Lương Hùng. 2022. Hệ thống nguyên âm tiếng Nùng Vẻn [The vowel system of Nung Ven]. Ngôn ngữ 2022(9): 31-35. Hà Nội: Viện Ngôn ngữ học. (Wayback copy of sti.vista.gov.vn/tw/Lists/TaiLieuKHCN/Attachments/351187/)
sources.note: Nothing. Articulatory + Praat F1/F2 study of 11 monophthongs and /ɯa/ (2,000-item 2022 fieldwork, Cả Tiểng, Nội Thôn, Hà Quảng); tones appear only as Chao digits in transcriptions; no mention of trọng âm/stress, syllable types or presyllables. Sec. 2 summarises Edmondson, Nguyễn Văn Lợi, Hoàng Văn Ma & Tạ Văn Thông 1999 (10-vowel system).

sources.citation: Edmondson, Jerold A. [2002 draft, PDF title 'Kra for Curzon']. Kra or Kadai languages. Pre-publication draft of the chapter published in Diller, Edmondson & Luo (eds.) 2008, The Tai-Kadai Languages, 653-677. London: Routledge. Wayback capture 2012-03-15 of ling.uta.edu/~jerry/byte-identical to the 2004 capture already on file in../aoua1234).
sources.note: Nothing for En: En (Nùng Vên) is listed among the seven Kra languages and among those preserving codas, but the 'En.' section heading at the end of the draft is empty. Only prosodic remark is second-hand for Buyang ('sequi-syllabic structure with the first syllable being toneless', after Li 1999).

sources.citation: Edmondson, Jerold A. 2002. The Laha language and its position in Proto-Kra. SEALS XII paper (author's PDF, Wayback 2004 capture of ling.uta.edu/~jerry/); read on file as../laha1250/.
sources.note: En mentioned only as a newly discovered Kra language of Cao Bằng added to Ostapirat's tree (fn. 2); no En data, nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Edmondson, Jerold A. & Kenneth J. Gregerson. 2001. Four languages of the Vietnam-China borderlands. In Papers from the Sixth Annual Meeting of SEALS, 101-133. Tempe: ASU. (on file../bouy1240/)
sources.note: Treats Kam, Sui, Pa-hng and Giáy only; En not covered.

sources.citation: Edmondson, Jerold A., Kenneth J. Gregerson & Nguyễn Văn Lợi. [c. 2001]. Borderlands: Lesser Known Indigenous Languages of Northern Vietnam (NSF SBR-9511285/SBR-9729043 project pages), 'Lesser Known Languages of Northern Vietnam' and map/language notes item '9. Nung Ven'; plus /research/NungVen/ sound-file directory. Wayback captures of ling.uta.edu/~jerry/research/, /research/, /research/NungVen/.
sources.note: Nothing. Discovery note only (c. 200 speakers in Noi Thon, Ha Quang; autonym En; Kra/'outlier' affiliation; <50% shared vocabulary with other Kra languages). NungVen directory = MP3 folders only.
